== Earlier published Set 0 slip, 13 November 2026 ==
The archived Set 0 master PDF, page 9, prints “Your leaders are deploy -2 to same site.” The July 2018 PC image omits that sentence. The PDF was captured on 6 August 2016 and its cover states official text as of 1 August 2016. The capture establishes availability by that date, not the card’s initial release date. The 2017 capture has the same visible Harc slip; negligible rendering noise does not establish another version. The original fan scan has not been reassigned: this PDF reproduces only the lower gameplay slip, so it cannot verify the scan’s complete upper face. The official PDF slip is used as the image for the newly documented earlier version. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

The source slip directly establishes power, ability, armor, deploy, forfeit, the pilot bonus, game text, Set 0 mark and lower caption. The article’s upper-face destiny, lore, card type and rarity are retained from the underlying [[Harc Seff]]; they are not reproduced by this lower-only slip. The full fan scan is not assigned as this source’s complete card face. The earlier Talk history accompanies the July 2018 image at [[Talk:Harc Seff (V) (Errata)]].
